entities.summary: "Work Your Magic" is a single released by Dmitry Koldun, which ranked 6th in the Eurovision Song Contest 2007 in Helsinki, representing Belarus. The title is a pun on the artist's surname, since koldun (колдун) in Russian means "magician" or "sorcerer".
